info.name: Library Management API
info.description:
Merged collection: Auth (per role), Books, Authors, Categories, Members, Borrowings.

Setup: import the environment file, select it, fill in the owner credentials, then run Auth > Login. Secrets (tokens, passwords) live in the environment; fixture ids and ids created by scripts live in collection variables.

Tokens: the collection pre-request script logs a role in automatically whenever its `{role}_token` is empty (for example after Logout), so you no longer need to run Auth > Login first. Logout sets the token to an empty string instead of deleting the variable. Self-registration always creates a `member`; the `role` field is ignored.
Borrowings: run folder `0. Setup (run once)` once per database, then folders 1, 2, 3a and 3b in order. Keep `max_active_loans` (collection variable) equal to `LIBRARY_MAX_ACTIVE_LOANS` in .env.

Module layout: Books, Authors, Categories and Members follow the same layout as Borrowings. Each has `0. Setup (run once)` (fixtures), `1. Staff` (create, list with filters, view, update, delete, restore, force delete), `2. Member` (what a member may and may not do), `3a. Rules` (business rules, two-step delete) and `3b. Errors and edge cases` (401, 404, 422, cleanup). Run each module's folders in order. Folders use `librarian_token` for staff work, `member_token` for member checks and `owner_token` only where the owner is required (force delete, cleanup).
Requests marked 'known gap' or 'if this is red' describe behaviour that the plan requires but the API may not enforce yet; a red result there is a finding, not a collection bug.
